reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: AI and data centres in national investment pitch
themes.definition: AI and data centre projects presented as part of a national flagship development/investment project (Gelephu Mindfulness City) powered by renewable energy and designed to attract investors.
themes.inclusion: Include passages promoting national AI/data centre projects, investment deals, or clean-energy-powered AI industries as national economic strategy.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages calling for international AI governance.
themes.boundary_cases: Brief listing of AI among 'industries of the future' in an investment pitch counts here if tied to a concrete national project; otherwise AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence and data center projects are moving forward, and nearly $5 billion in projects are under active negotiation.
That electricity will power GMC and the industries of the future. advanced manufacturing, scientific research, artificial intelligence and data centers

themes.label: AI alongside human consciousness and values
themes.definition: AI juxtaposed with spiritual, contemplative traditions and quality of life, presenting technology and human values as complementary rather than contradictory.
themes.inclusion: Include passages pairing AI with mindfulness, spirituality or human wellbeing as a deliberate design principle.
themes.exclusion: Exclude ethics-regulation passages focused on rights or bias.
themes.boundary_cases: Rhetorical questions about how to use AI in governance design fit here when framed around values; plain investment claims go to AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: Artificial intelligence and human consciousness. Data centers and meditation centers.
How would we use technology and especially artificial intelligence?

value.rationale: All three passages come from Bhutan's 'sales pitch' for Gelephu Mindfulness City, where AI appears as an investment sector (data centres, clean energy) and as a symbol paired with Buddhist contemplative traditions. There is no governance or risk discussion.
